_comment: Pterodactyl egg for Streamer Alerts Bot. Import via Admin -> Nests -> Import Egg.
name: Streamer Alerts Bot
author: bankkroll.eth@gmail.com
description: Discord bot that posts live alerts for Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Rumble and TikTok streamers. No API keys or database required.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; npm install --no-audit --no-fund; node index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y git ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ -d .git ]; then
  git pull
else
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/src
  cp -a /tmp/src/. /mnt/server/
fi
npm install --no-audit --no-fund
npm run build
echo "Install complete"

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot -> Reset Token).

variables.name: Application ID
variables.description: Application ID from the Discord Developer Portal (General Information).

variables.name: Guild ID
variables.description: Optional. Register slash commands to one server for instant availability. Leave empty to register globally (up to an hour to appear).

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Repository to install from. Point this at your fork to run your own changes.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest code from the repository on every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: One of: debug, info, warn, error, silent.
